scope: 30_34 boundary seed handoff to downstream veteran/retirement owners

consumerMatrixEvidence.rule: The matrix is an evidence snapshot, not sole current authority. Current runtime writers in this branch are authoritative for producer provenance; current-main source search is used only to corroborate downstream consumer evidence.

handoffs.requiredDecision: Register a semantically real downstream reader, define a canonically supported terminal disposition, or explicitly keep the seed open. Its three current writers represent converging late-career priority decisions and must not be collapsed to one provenance source.
Use only if downstream retirement/public scenes truly react to the established public tone; otherwise leave open or terminalize only with canonical evidence.

A downstream scene may read it only when a prior public home commitment materially changes that scene. Preserve whether the memory came from the direct home promise or the retirement interview; do not synthesize a single fake origin.
Do not consume from a generic veteran-market event; the downstream reader must react to the actual four-way late-career choice memory.
Use only where veteran leadership history changes responsibility, succession or legacy; otherwise leave open.
A reader must react specifically to the established short-turnaround physical limit; generic age/fatigue is not equivalent.

nonBoundaryOpenSeedExample.reason: Current source search also finds no demonstrated live reader, but its age-30 semantics do not by themselves prove a 34+/retirement boundary ownership. It remains in ordinary T5.2 open-seed classification.

integrationRule: This handoff is deliberately non-prescriptive. Downstream owners may add a proven consumer without changing the producer or rewriting history. If no consumer is canonically justified, keeping the seed open is preferable to an invented read or terminal transition.
